lines.zh: 我的步子很僵，一步一步。
lines.en: My steps are stiff, one at a time.

lines.zh: 我拖着一根木杆，压在土上。
lines.en: I drag a wooden pole across the soil.

lines.zh: 我穿过麦子，麦子分开又合。
lines.en: I pass through wheat, and it parts and closes.
I walk toward the house with the lit window.
I reach the field's edge and stop to look.

lines.zh: 我的袖子空空的，晃来晃去。
lines.en: My empty sleeves swing as I go.
I don't walk fast, but I never stray.

lines.zh: 我的帽子压得低，遮住脸。
lines.en: My hat sits low, hiding my face.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，乌鸦都飞了。
lines.en: Where I walk, the crows take flight.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转向你的那一边。
lines.en: I turn slowly to your side.

lines.zh: 我站在田中央，一动不动。
lines.en: I stand in the middle of the field, still.

lines.zh: 我身上的稻草有点散了。
lines.en: The straw on me is coming loose.

lines.zh: 乌鸦落在我肩上，又飞走。
lines.en: A crow lands on my shoulder and flies off.

lines.zh: 我在等，田里的东西都在等。
lines.en: I wait, and everything in the field waits.

lines.zh: 我的手垂着，指头是树枝。
lines.en: My hands hang, fingers made of twigs.

lines.zh: 我听见风穿过我的肋骨。
lines.en: I hear wind through my ribs.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己看了多久的田。
lines.en: I don't know how long I've watched this field.
I look up; the sky is grey.

lines.zh: 我的木杆插在土里，很深。
lines.en: My pole is set deep in the soil.

lines.zh: 有虫子在我身上爬，我不动。
lines.en: Bugs crawl on me; I don't stir.

lines.zh: 我的脸是画上去的，早褪了。
lines.en: My face was painted on; it's faded.
I remember the smell of autumn.
I count the rows in the field.
I neither eat nor sleep; I only stand.

lines.zh: 我把头歪了一点，慢慢停住。
lines.en: I tilt my head a little and hold it.
A house far off has its lamp lit.
You've stepped into the field.
I know that way of walking.
I can see the lamp in your hand.

lines.zh: 我低下头，帽檐遮着眼睛。
lines.en: I lower my head, brim over my eyes.

lines.zh: 你不该在收割的时候来。
lines.en: You shouldn't come at harvest time.
I've stood here many years.

lines.zh: 你背后那些乌鸦，是我的。
lines.en: Those crows behind you are mine.
I can't name you.
Three paces from me; that's about right.

lines.zh: 你听见稻草的声音了吗？
lines.en: Do you hear the straw?

lines.zh: 我看你的影子，比看你的脸久。
lines.en: I watch your shadow longer than your face.
There's nothing else alive in this field.

lines.zh: 稻草掉了一把，我捡不回来。
lines.en: A handful of straw falls and I can't gather it.

lines.zh: 我被撕开一道口，里面空的。
lines.en: A tear opens; there's nothing inside.

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，木杆撑住了。
lines.en: I sway, and my pole holds me up.

lines.zh: 我的帽子歪了，我慢慢扶正。
lines.en: My hat's knocked crooked; I slowly fix it.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，土上留下坑。
lines.en: I step back, leaving a hollow.
I don't cry out; straw has no voice.
I stuff the loose straw back in.

lines.zh: 我的袖子破了，风灌进来。
lines.en: My sleeve is torn; wind pours in.
I'm still standing, and the field remains.
That wheat in your hand smells good.

lines.zh: 新割的稻草，我想补自己。
lines.en: Fresh straw; I'd patch myself with it.
Bring the lamp closer.

lines.zh: 我身上缺了一块，能给我吗？
lines.en: I'm missing a piece; may I have it?
That light reminds me of the sun.
Stay a little longer.
I take half a step toward you.
Leave that bundle of straw on the ground.

lines.zh: 有新布的味道，是刚缝的。
lines.en: Smells of new cloth, freshly sewn.

lines.zh: 你撞了我，稻草抖了一下。
lines.en: You bump me; my straw shivers.
A few straws fall on you.
I block you and don't step aside.
Your hand goes into my sleeve.
We collide, and the crows startle.
You knocked my pole askew.

lines.zh: 我退了一步，土被踩出坑。
lines.en: I step back, leaving a hollow.

lines.zh: 我贴着你不倒，靠着木杆。
lines.en: I lean on my pole and don't fall.

lines.zh: 碰到我的人都带走一身草屑。
lines.en: Anyone who touches me leaves with straw dust.
Another stands at the far end of the field.
She's older than I am, her straw yellower.

lines.zh: 我们隔着整片麦子对望。
lines.en: We look at each other across the whole field.
The crows go back and forth between us.
Her pole stands straighter than mine.

lines.zh: 我们不说话，风替我们说。
lines.en: We don't speak; the wind speaks for us.
At dark, we turn our heads together.
Straw dust settles on her too.
Two shadows cross the ridge.

lines.zh: 收割之后，我们还站在这里。
lines.en: After the harvest, we're still standing here.

lines.zh: 我拾起一把落下的麦穗。
lines.en: I pick up a fallen ear of wheat.

lines.zh: 我把你的帽子挂回你头上。
lines.en: I hang your hat back on your head.

lines.zh: 我捡起一根断枝，插进袖子。
lines.en: I pick up a broken twig and slide it into my sleeve.

lines.zh: 我拾起掉在地上的稻草。
lines.en: I pick up the straw from the ground.

lines.zh: 我把你的刀捡起来，递过去。
lines.en: I pick up your knife and hold it out.

lines.zh: 我捡起一枚乌鸦的羽毛。
lines.en: I pick up a crow's feather.

lines.zh: 我把倒在地上的杆扶起来。
lines.en: I raise the fallen pole.

lines.zh: 我拾起一块石头，塞进胸口。
lines.en: I pick up a stone and tuck it in my chest.
I set your dropped lantern upright.

lines.zh: 我捡起一片枯叶，看了看。
lines.en: I pick up a dead leaf and look at it.
You trampled the field I keep.

lines.zh: 乌鸦先看见了你，我随后。
lines.en: The crows saw you first; then I did.
I raise my head; the brim lifts.
Only crops belong in this field.
I turn toward you.
Did you hear the straw?

lines.zh: 我的枝手指一根根张开。
lines.en: My twig fingers spread one by one.
I won't yield this season.

lines.zh: 你身上有我讨厌的味道。
lines.en: You carry a smell I dislike.
I've blocked the ridge path.

lines.zh: 你走不出去的，田是圆的。
lines.en: You can't leave; the field is a circle.
The crows have all come down.
I lift one end of my pole.
Listen; the wheat is rustling.
It's harvest time.

lines.zh: 你站的这块田，我记下了。
lines.en: I've marked the patch you stand on.
I've watched this patch for many years.

lines.zh: 我一步一步走过去，很僵。
lines.en: I go step by step, stiffly.
You go left; my head follows.
I drag my pole on the ground.
The crows circle above you.

lines.zh: 你退到篱笆边，篱笆很高。
lines.en: You back to the fence; it's tall.
I stop among the wheat.
Do you hear the stalks breaking?
These eyes of mine never close.
The wind fills my sleeves.
Ten more steps and I'm there.
There's only one path through the field.
I pull my hat a little lower.
The lamplight sways; your hands shake.
I stop and let the wind pass.
The soil under you is loose.
I don't call out; the field is too quiet.

lines.zh: 你回头看了一眼，我还在。
lines.en: You glance back; I'm still there.
As the light fails, I grow clearer.
I raise a hand to shoulder height.
The pole sweeps across.
My hand closes on your sleeve.
Twig fingers rake across.
I press you down into the wheat.
The crows dive and bite for me.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，很慢，但你躲不开。
lines.en: I raise a hand, slow, yet you can't dodge.

lines.zh: 这一下打断了半行麦子。
lines.en: That flattened half a row of wheat.
My pole ends at your chest.
You pull back; straw scatters.
I catch your foot and drag.
I shove you, and the soil gives.
My backhand crosses your face.
I bear down on you, heavy.
I let go, and you rise again.
A figure stands up in the field.
Someone bundled me from straw.

lines.zh: 我被插在田中央，一插很多年。
lines.en: I was set in the field's middle for many years.
After dark, I moved.
The crows landed on my shoulder first.
Someone gave me this hat.
The wheat is ripe; I should wake.

lines.zh: 我抬起头，第一次看见月亮。
lines.en: I raise my head and see the moon for the first time.
The rope around me has loosened.
The soil on the ridge is still fresh.

lines.zh: 我的木杆从土里拔出来。
lines.en: My pole pulls free of the soil.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，草屑落了一地。
lines.en: I shake, and straw dust falls.
Someone carries a lamp far off.
I stand here and watch the field.
The wind fades my face further.
I remember last season.

lines.zh: 我听见有东西在田里走。
lines.en: I hear something walking in the field.
My hands move first, then my body.
This season, I'll be watching.

lines.zh: 稻草一下就着，我拍着往前走。
lines.en: The straw catches at once; I walk on, beating it.
I fall, and the pole snaps first.
Water soaks me soft, and I grow heavy.

lines.zh: 气浪把稻草吹散，我散了一半。
lines.en: The blast scatters my straw; half of me is gone.
An arrow passes through, carrying off straw.
A spell fixes me where I stand.

lines.zh: 我不用吃，但田野变空了。
lines.en: I don't eat, yet the field grows empty.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的稻草焦了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; my straw is scorched.
There's no field here, and no wind.
